findings.finding: wrong_run_binding, wrong_input_or_pin, duplicate_keys_or_non_utf8 and oversized_or_symlink_file specify rejected/unavailable but do not specify second-file presence or injection setup. invalid_first_valid_second instead specifies rejected/rejected. Present-but-withheld and absent need distinct deterministic treatment.
findings.qualification: Not a demonstrated contradiction solely from worker success: event_without_file explicitly has success with no files. Phase events do not prove checkpoints exist. Tinker withdrew the stronger presence inference; this review independently confirms under-specification only.
findings.required_change: Version the matrix with explicit checkpoint presence/content/validation fault setup at each ordinal and reconciliation/leader conditions. Define absent versus present-after-prior-rejection mapping and fixed reason codes; apply consistently to all scenarios, including missing-first, invalid-first and malformed files. Update static coverage checks and obtain fresh exact design review before implementation.
findings.why: An implementation could satisfy the current ambiguous rows by treating a withheld present file as absent, making an incorrect report indistinguishable from the intended one.

findings.finding: A separate exclusively created bounded reconciliation-output file is required by prose but has no numeric byte limit. Verifier phase must fit work budget after cleanup reserve, yet phase names/caps/cleanup/exit allowance are not fixed. The20s total envelope alone does not instantiate the accepted supervisor invocation.
findings.required_change: Specify a numeric reconciliation-output byte cap, exact bounded schema/field counts and cap+1 rejection at parent read, plus ordered verifier phase(s), phase/exit/cleanup caps and behavior when the remaining budget is insufficient. Bind invocation to min(20, remaining-10) without fresh windows. Include oversize/malformed/duplicate-key verifier output and verifier timeout/cleanup faults in acceptance obligations.
findings.qualification: 570+20+10 arithmetic is correct; no evidence of actual deadline overrun. Missing design parameters require revision, not implementation or runtime failure claims.

positive_design_assessment.expectation_adequacy: Valid prefix, metadata/case/run outcome separation and no fallback for missing/rejected/not-reconciled cases are sound directions; deterministic fault setup is required by F1.
positive_design_assessment.deadline: One outer monotonic budget and reserved reconciliation/report work avoid resetting600s.180*3+2=542 fits570; OS stalls/process creation/serialization remain explicitly unproven.
positive_design_assessment.privacy: Never wholesale raw v2 result. Frozen projection only after exact actual validation; omit raw reasons/candidates/model assessments/extensions/paths/run_id. Sentinel obligations and prefix/full digest distinction appropriate, but no sanitizer implementation evaluated.
positive_design_assessment.file_races: Fresh0700directory/one trusted writer, exclusive0600temp/no-overwrite prerequisites, nofollow/regularfile/singlelink/owner/size/descriptor rechecks and duplicate-key strictUTF8 parsing are sensible bounded requirements. Ordinary rename is not adversarial no-clobber; hostile same-owner filesystem outside scope.
positive_design_assessment.lifecycle: Leader reaping before reads and all-null not_reconciled on verifier failure avoid publishing uncommitted verifier output. Escaped descendants not excluded by accepted supervisor; trusted non-escaping fixture worker is necessary. Cleanup-before-publish/fixed no-report error preserve failure visibility; crash orphan cleanup remains an explicit later implementation requirement.
